    # Identify the two most frequent colors; remove any contiguous block matching
    # the repeated solid color band in the demonstration.
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The feature is the sole full row of foreground, erase it only if present.
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v != bg for v in row):
            out[i] = [bg] * len(row)
    return out

    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    first = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)), len(grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
